text: Assumption: For accesses to the same SignalId, external protection by the caller is necessary — is this correct?

norm: for accesses to the same signalid external protection by the caller is necessary
assumption: For accesses to the same SignalId, external protection by the caller is necessary.
rationale: SWS_Com_91005 defines the service for the same SignalId as non-reentrant ("Non Reentrant for the same signal").

original.text: Annahme: Bei Zugriffen auf dieselbe SignalId dürfte eine externe Absicherung durch den Aufrufer nötig sein — trifft das zu?
